why: Scores: base STR 15 DEX 14 CON 13 INT 12 WIS 10 CHA 8 plus Soldier (STR +2, CON +1) = STR 17 (+3), DEX 14 (+2), CON 14 (+2), INT 12 (+1), WIS 10 (0), CHA 8 (-1). Fighter 5 + Rogue 15, level 20, PB 6. First class Fighter: STR 3+6 = 9, CON 2+6 = 8. The Rogue core saves (DEX, INT) are not granted: DEX 2, INT 1. Slippery Mind is a Rogue 15 feature (not a starting proficiency), so it applies: WIS 0+6 = 6, CHA -1+6 = 5.
